import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 12,
    'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'figure.facecolor': '#FAFAFA',
    'axes.facecolor': '#FAFAFA',
    'axes.edgecolor': '#CCCCCC',
    'axes.grid': True,
    'grid.color': '#E0E0E0',
    'grid.linewidth': 0.5,
    'grid.alpha': 0.7,
})

COLORS = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': '#C0392B',
    'South Asia': '#E67E22',
    'Europe': '#2980B9',
    'North America': '#27AE60',
}
regions = ['Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia', 'Europe', 'North America']

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 14), dpi=150)
fig.suptitle('The Global Digital Divide: Internet Penetration Inequality Across Four Dimensions (2023)',
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.97, color='#1A1A1A')
fig.text(0.5, 0.945, 'Penetration rates (%) by income, age, urban–rural setting, and region  |  Sources: ITU, World Bank, Pew Research Center',
         ha='center', fontsize=10, color='#666666')

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(2, 2, hspace=0.35, wspace=0.28, left=0.07, right=0.95, top=0.91, bottom=0.06)

# --- Panel A: Income quintile (slope/line chart) ---
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
quintiles = ['Q1\n(Lowest)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5\n(Highest)']
income_data = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': [6, 14, 25, 42, 68],
    'South Asia': [12, 24, 39, 56, 78],
    'Europe': [72, 82, 89, 94, 97],
    'North America': [75, 85, 92, 96, 99],
}
x = np.arange(len(quintiles))
for r in regions:
    vals = income_data[r]
    ax1.plot(x, vals, 'o-', color=COLORS[r], linewidth=2.2, markersize=6, label=r, zorder=3)
    ax1.annotate(f'{vals[0]}%', (x[0], vals[0]), textcoords='offset points',
                 xytext=(-18, -4), fontsize=8, color=COLORS[r], fontweight='bold')
    ax1.annotate(f'{vals[-1]}%', (x[-1], vals[-1]), textcoords='offset points',
                 xytext=(6, -4), fontsize=8, color=COLORS[r], fontweight='bold')

    # Gap annotation for the two low-penetration regions
    if r in ('Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia'):
        gap = vals[-1] - vals[0]
        mid_y = (vals[0] + vals[-1]) / 2
        ax1.annotate(f'Gap: {gap}pp', xy=(4.3, mid_y), fontsize=8, color=COLORS[r],
                     fontstyle='italic', ha='left')

ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(quintiles, fontsize=9)
ax1.set_ylabel('Internet Penetration (%)')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 105)
ax1.set_title('A. Income Gradient', loc='left')

# --- Panel B: Age groups (line chart) ---
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
age_groups = ['15–24', '25–34', '35–44', '45–54', '55–64', '65+']
age_data = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': [38, 32, 26, 18, 11, 5],
    'South Asia': [55, 48, 38, 27, 16, 8],
    'Europe': [98, 96, 93, 88, 79, 58],
    'North America': [99, 97, 95, 91, 84, 65],
}
x2 = np.arange(len(age_groups))
for r in regions:
    vals = age_data[r]
    ax2.plot(x2, vals, 'o-', color=COLORS[r], linewidth=2.2, markersize=6, label=r, zorder=3)
    ax2.annotate(f'{vals[0]}%', (x2[0], vals[0]), textcoords='offset points',
                 xytext=(-18, -4), fontsize=8, color=COLORS[r], fontweight='bold')
    ax2.annotate(f'{vals[-1]}%', (x2[-1], vals[-1]), textcoords='offset points',
                 xytext=(6, -4), fontsize=8, color=COLORS[r], fontweight='bold')

ax2.set_xticks(x2)
ax2.set_xticklabels(age_groups, fontsize=9)
ax2.set_ylabel('Internet Penetration (%)')
ax2.set_ylim(0, 105)
ax2.set_title('B. Age Divide (Youth → Elder)', loc='left')

# --- Panel C: Urban-Rural gap (paired bar / dumbbell) ---
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
urban_rural = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': (42, 13),
    'South Asia': (58, 22),
    'Europe': (92, 78),
    'North America': (95, 80),
}
y_pos = np.arange(len(regions))
for i, r in enumerate(regions):
    u, ru = urban_rural[r]
    ax3.plot([ru, u], [i, i], color=COLORS[r], linewidth=3, zorder=2)
    ax3.scatter([ru], [i], color='white', edgecolor=COLORS[r], linewidth=2, s=80, zorder=3)
    ax3.scatter([u], [i], color=COLORS[r], s=80, zorder=3)
    gap = u - ru
    ax3.text(u + 1.5, i, f'{u}%', va='center', fontsize=9, color=COLORS[r], fontweight='bold')
    ax3.text(ru - 1.5, i, f'{ru}%', va='center', ha='right', fontsize=9, color=COLORS[r], fontweight='bold')
    ax3.text((u + ru) / 2, i + 0.25, f'Gap: {gap}pp', va='bottom', ha='center',
             fontsize=8, color='#444444', fontstyle='italic')

ax3.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax3.set_yticklabels(regions, fontsize=9)
ax3.set_xlim(0, 105)
ax3.set_xlabel('Internet Penetration (%)')
ax3.set_title('C. Urban–Rural Gap', loc='left')
ax3.invert_yaxis()
# Custom legend for dumbbell
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
legend_elements = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='#555', markersize=8, markerfacecolor='#555', label='Urban', linestyle='None'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='#555', markersize=8, markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=2, label='Rural', linestyle='None'),
]
ax3.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='lower right', fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9)

# --- Panel D: Overall regional penetration (horizontal bar with population) ---
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
overall = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': (27, 1210, 327),
    'South Asia': (40, 1980, 792),
    'Europe': (89, 750, 668),
    'North America': (93, 380, 353),
}
for i, r in enumerate(regions):
    pct, pop, users = overall[r]
    ax4.barh(i, pct, color=COLORS[r], height=0.55, zorder=2, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    ax4.text(pct + 1.5, i, f'{pct}%', va='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS[r])
    ax4.text(pct - 2, i, f'{users}M / {pop}M', va='center', ha='right',
             fontsize=8, color='white', fontweight='bold')

ax4.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax4.set_yticklabels(regions, fontsize=9)
ax4.set_xlim(0, 105)
ax4.set_xlabel('Internet Penetration (%)')
ax4.set_title('D. Overall Regional Penetration', loc='left')
ax4.invert_yaxis()

# Shared legend for panels A and B
handles, labels = ax1.get_legend_handles_labels()
fig.legend(handles, labels, loc='lower center', ncol=4, fontsize=10,
           frameon=True, fancybox=True, edgecolor='#CCCCCC', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.005))

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='#FAFAFA')
print('Done')
